summary: ASTRA is an educational space exploration and simulation game that lets players take on different roles within a mission, such as mission director or astronaut. Players must plan, manage, and carry out exploration missions on various celestial bodies, making decisions that directly affect their success.
details:
ASTRA – Exploration Simulator

ASTRA is an immersive educational simulation game that places players at the heart of a space exploration mission. Unlike many games that focus solely on the end result, our project emphasizes the entire journey of a mission, from its design to its execution.

Players can take on different roles essential to the success of a space mission, including mission director, systems engineer, scientist, or astronaut. Each role carries specific responsibilities and confronts the player with decisions inspired by the challenges of real space missions.

The gameplay is built on a combination of management, planning, and exploration. Players prepare their mission, select the necessary equipment, manage limited resources, and explore different extraterrestrial environments in order to collect scientific data and achieve defined objectives. Every decision directly shapes the course of the mission and helps players better understand the constraints of space exploration.

Our project has two major impacts.

The first is educational. ASTRA offers children, teenagers, and space enthusiasts a simulated environment in which to discover the realities of space exploration. Players learn how missions are prepared, how astronauts work in the field, which technical constraints must be taken into account, and how scientific teams collaborate to reach their goals. Our ambition is to inspire careers in science, technology, engineering, and space exploration.

The second impact is social and inspirational. We want to offer young enthusiasts an immersive experience that stimulates their scientific curiosity, develops their ability to solve complex problems, and strengthens their interest in scientific and technological careers. In doing so, we hope to help train the next generation of explorers, engineers, and researchers.

One of the most important aspects of the project is its use of NASA scientific resources. ASTRA draws on data and documentation from NASA missions and programs to design credible environments, realistic scenarios, and coherent scientific objectives. In particular, we use resources related to the Perseverance, Dragonfly, Europa Clipper, and OSIRIS-REx missions, as well as planetary and topographic data such as LOLA DEM and SLDEM2015, to draw inspiration from real extraterrestrial environments.

The creative aspect of the project lies in combining several dimensions within a single experience: mission simulation, decision-making, resource management, immersive exploration, scientific learning, and teamwork. The game is not limited to the Moon; it was designed to accommodate many celestial bodies such as Mars, Europa, Titan, asteroids, or any other future exploration destination.

During development, our team took several key factors into account: accessibility for beginners, scientific consistency, educational value, player immersion, ease of use, reuse of NASA resources, and the possibility of extending the project to new missions and new worlds.

Technologies Used

  • Languages: C++ and Blueprint
  • Game engine: Unreal Engine (with the possibility of adaptation to Unity)
  • Project management: Git
  • Development tools: Unreal Engine Editor, Blueprint System, and 3D modeling tools

Expected Impact

We hope that ASTRA will become a fun and educational tool capable of inspiring young people to take an interest in space, science, and engineering. Beyond competition, our goal is to create a platform that fosters a better understanding of the challenges of space exploration while developing curiosity, creativity, collaboration, and a spirit of discovery.

Our Motto:
“Design the mission. Explore the unknown. Inspire the future.”
